**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bind experiment members to their required suite types**

When an experiment index points its members at the wrong suites, this branch checks only the member names and their individual pass statuses, not their required kind or cohort. I reproduced a fresh `PASSED` experiment by pointing `base`, `successor`, and `challenges` at the same passing base `demo` directory: no conventional/outside/AI comparison cells, successor runs, or challenges were required. Validate that the members resolve to a base comparison, a successor comparison, and the registered challenge suite respectively before accepting complete-experiment coverage.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
